headline: Nevish Line Rekindles as Passage and Row Churn
war_summary: Since the morning wire the Nevish Line has rekindled with nine changes in two hours and seventeen on the day around Princefal and Tomb Father at six Warden to two Colonial holdings, with 6,618 Colonial and 6,406 Warden casualties on the day. Fisherman's Row remains fast with six changes in two hours and fifty-eight on the day about Dankana Post and Eidolo at seven Colonial holdings and two neutral, the latest wire at the hour. Callahan's Passage eases to three changes in two hours though sixty-eight on the day about The Latch at ten Warden holdings, with 12,396 Colonial and 14,627 Warden casualties. Stlican Shelf stands at three Warden to six Colonial with one change in two hours and sixty on the day about Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost. Mooring County posts three changes in two hours about The Wind Hills at eleven Warden to one Colonial, while Viper Pit shows three late changes at Moltworth amid sharp casualty rates. The Weathered Expanse, Stonecradle, Linn Mercy and Marban Hollow record no changes in the last two hours.
